statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41989: libgcrypt before 1.12.2 can overflow a heap buffer when gcry_pk_decrypt decodes a crafted ECDH ciphertext point on a Montgomery curve, because _gcry_ecc_mont_decodepoint() pads short input incorrectly (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-41989, https://dev.gnupg.org/T8211, https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/04/21/1). Upstream fixed it in libgcrypt commit 2d3d732c9bf87cc10729f69678dd9e6862f99fa3 (libgcrypt 1.12.2); the bug was introduced in 1.9.0. Debian backported that commit to trixie in 1.11.0-7+deb13u1 (DSA-6294-1). The DHI libgcrypt20 package for Debian 13 is a rebuild of Debian's 1.11.0-7+deb13u1; the one build the DHI Debian repository publishes (amd64 and arm64), which is the fixed version used here, ships a Debian changelog that records the Montgomery-curve point decoding fix for CVE-2026-41989.
